### Waters and Labcorp to Expand Access to Cervical Cancer Screening with the Most Comprehensive FDA-Approved HPV Testing Option Beginning in Late 2026


October 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/962852172/files/doc_news/Waters-and-Labcorp-to-Expand-Access-to-Cervical-Cancer-Screening-with-the-Most-Comprehensive-FDA-Approved-HPV-Testing-Option-Beginnin-DWPKY.pdf)


- Labcorp intends to be the first commercial laboratory to offer FDA-approved HPV testing with the BD Onclarity™ HPV Assay across clinician-collected and self-collected screening options in clinic, patient service center, and at-home settings
- Through a network serving more than 850,000 physicians and healthcare providers and more than 2,200 patient service centers, Labcorp is helping expand access to cervical cancer screening nationwide
- First and only FDA-approved HPV test that supports all ASCCP Enduring Risk-Based Management Guidelines by providing comprehensive extended genotyping


MILFORD, Mass. and BURLINGTON, N.C.


, Oct. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Labcorp (NYSE: LH), a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services, and Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), a global life sciences and diagnostics leader, today announced a partnership to expand access to the FDA-approved BD Onclarity HPV Assay through Labcorp's nationwide laboratory network beginning in late 2026.


Cervical cancer is largely preventable through routine screening and early detection of human papillomavirus (HPV), yet millions of women remain overdue for recommended tests. This collaboration is designed to help address persistent cervical cancer screening gaps by bringing more accessible screening options to patients across the United States. Labcorp will provide these HPV testing options to support its clinician programs, Gaps in Care health plan programs, and Labcorp OnDemand consumer channel.2-8


"Barriers such as privacy, access, and socioeconomic factors can make it difficult to stay current with cervical cancer screening," said Jeff Andrews, M.D., FRCSC, Vice President of Medical Affairs, Waters Advanced Diagnostics, Waters Corporation.5-7 "We are at the start of a new era in which screening can extend beyond the clinic, enable more personalized risk assessment, and reach people who have historically been underserved. By offering greater flexibility in how and where people are screened, our collaboration marks a critical step forward in bridging one of today's most profound care gaps."


**The Most Comprehensive FDA-Approved HPV Testing Option** The BD Onclarity HPV Assay is the only FDA-approved HPV test that supports all American Society for Colposcopy and Cervical Pathology (ASCCP) Enduring Risk-Based Management Guidelines.2,9


"Cervical cancer screening saves lives, but too many women still face barriers to getting screened," said Dr. Brian Caveney, Chief Medical and Scientific Officer, Labcorp. "By expanding access and options for comprehensive FDA-approved HPV testing, we can help more women stay current with recommended screening, reach those who may be overdue for care, and support earlier identification of cervical cancer risk."


Certain HPV genotypes, including types 16, 18 and 45, are associated with an increased risk of cervical cancer, making genotype-specific information important for patient management.9 As HPV vaccination has reduced infections from HPV types 16 and 18, other high-risk HPV strains now account for a growing share of cervical disease, particularly among younger, vaccinated populations.10 The BD Onclarity HPV Assay offers extended genotyping that individually identifies HPV types 16, 18, 31, 45, 51 and 52 along with three sets of strategically pooled results, regardless of collection method, making it the most comprehensive HPV screening tool available in the U.S. today.2,11


Waters and Labcorp intend to offer the BD Onclarity HPV Assay by the end of 2026. To learn more, visit[https://womenshealth.labcorp.com/providers/cervical-cancer-screening](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4804998-1&h=127160292&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwomenshealth.labcorp.com%2Fproviders%2Fcervical-cancer-screening&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwomenshealth.labcorp.com%2Fproviders%2Fcervical-cancer-screening) .


**About Labcorp:**
Labcorp (NYSE: LH) is a global leader of innovative and comprehensive laboratory services that helps doctors, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, researchers and patients make clear and confident decisions. We provide insights and advance science to improve health and improve lives through our unparalleled diagnostics and drug development laboratory capabilities. The company's nearly 71,000 employees serve clients in approximately 100 countries, provided support for more than 85% of the new drugs and therapeutic products approved by the FDA in 2025 and performed more than 750 million tests for patients around the world.
